newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Astra says gets UK nod for Colazide treatment.
newsitem.headline: Astra says gets UK nod for Colazide treatment.

text.p: Swedish drug company Astra said on Monday British authorities approved Colazide, or balsalazide, for acute treatment of the inflammatory bowel disease, ulcerative colitis.
Astra said in a statement that European approval is expected to follow because of the European mutual recognition process.
It said it was planning to launch the drug in Britain in the second half of 1997 and in the rest of Europe in 1998.
"Clinical studies indicate that Colazide is more effective than the current market leader in the treatment of mild to moderate ulcerative colitis," Astra said.
Astra said it had extensive market rights to Colazide through a licensing agreement with Salix Pharmaceuticals, Inc. of the United States.
Inflammatory bowel diseases are a significant medical problem, it said. "In 1996 the world market for these diseases was estimated at $550 million," Astra said.
